prompt.zh-TW: 雲嶺茶莊今年稅前淨利 {{money:vars.pretax}}，股本（實收資本）{{money:vars.capital}}。依課程 Excel 口徑計算{{term:tm_bkqw8c59|plain}}，以百分比作答。
prompt.en: Cloud Ridge Tea House had profit before tax of {{money:vars.pretax}} and share capital (paid-in capital) of {{money:vars.capital}}. Using the course Excel basis, what is the {{term:tm_bkqw8c59|plain}}? Answer as a percentage.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_bkqw8c59}}＝{{term:tm_z971merj}} ÷ {{term:tm_5e3py55a}}。分母是股東當初投入的股本，不含未分配盈餘，所以它是「相對股本的報酬率」，不是資產報酬率，也不等於 ROE。
explanation.en: {{term:tm_bkqw8c59}} = {{term:tm_z971merj}} ÷ {{term:tm_5e3py55a}}. The denominator is the capital the shareholders originally paid in, excluding retained earnings, so it is a return relative to share capital: not a return on assets, and not the same as ROE.
